confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not live listings. Restaurant anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation carries the widest uncertainty because July peak-season rates on Mykonos vary a lot by location and booking timing. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor, since direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. The FX observation comes from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open the RBA page directly to confirm the value.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against premium Greek island tourism pricing in peak summer (Cyclades-style island premium above mainland Greece, e.g. Athens as a lower baseline), with Mykonos placed at the high end of that island tier.
